target.title: refactor(ui): split Workboard controller modules
target.body:
Closes #105964

## What Problem This Solves

The Control UI Workboard controller lived in one 4,121-line module, making its state, normalization, lifecycle, polling, task-linking, mutation, and execution responsibilities difficult to review and test independently.

## Why This Change Was Made

Split the controller along existing responsibility seams into focused modules, while retaining `ui/src/lib/workboard/index.ts` as a 76-line public barrel with the exact prior 67 exports. The existing controller test moved beside the extracted implementation; runtime behavior and caller imports remain unchanged.

The full diff adds 4,487 lines and removes 4,123 lines (net +364, primarily module imports/exports). Every new production module is below 500 lines; the largest is 488 lines. No changelog entry: internal refactor with no user-visible behavior change.

## User Impact

No user-visible change. Maintainers get smaller Workboard modules with clearer ownership and more focused review/test seams.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcttxc65dkv6f613w8s3r97` / workflow run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29223378319
  - `corepack pnpm tsgo:ui`
  - `corepack pnpm tsgo:test:ui`
  - `corepack pnpm test ui/src/lib/workboard`: 232 files passed, 2 skipped; 3,726 tests passed, 11 skipped; Workboard controller suite 185 tests
- Mock-dev browser sanity: `pnpm dev:ui:mock`; Chromium loaded `/workboard` and asserted page title `Workboard`.
- Exact public surface comparison: 67 prior exports, 67 current exports, no missing or added names.
- Inline comment comparison: all 35 substantive comments preserved; only the former monolith header became the barrel header.
- Dead-code baselines: `pnpm deadcode:dependencies`, `pnpm deadcode:unused-files`, and `pnpm deadcode:exports` passed; all 5,517 unused-export entries matched.
- `git diff --check`: clean.
- Exact-head hosted CI https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29224341176: Workboard controller suite passed all 185 tests; 233 of 234 UI files passed. The only UI failure is unrelated `terminal-panel.test.ts` timing, which passed all 8 tests in fresh Testbox proof.
- Remaining hosted type/package-boundary failures all point to current-main `extensions/imessage/src/monitor/conversation-repair.ts`; fresh Testbox independently reproduced the same baseline error.
- Fresh autoreview: clean; no accepted/actionable findings.

AI-assisted: Codex performed the mechanical split, validation, and review under maintainer direction.
